conclusions.text: All 89,390 original cells are accounted for: 88722 genuine source-relative native qualifications and 668 explicit holds, preserving 91 owners. Complete source, physical and historical context remains.

London mixed-source positive authority, original whole-candidate discrepancies, GSHHG licence wording conflict, contemporary legal/dry-land claims and final selected/current-owner-zero/emitted delivery remain unresolved or pending.

limits: The executed negative-only helper is independently reviewed commit 39c75ec44a08c245762cc3c0e9cec796c4fcd5c2 in PR #2347, a prepared dependency not asserted merged at execution. The manifest review base is the actual currently accepted main commit.
No selected ownership, cumulative ledger, emitted raster, regional certificate, deployment or accepted repair credit changes in this source-authority handoff.

GBR ADM2 contains 216 whole features from ONS with a 2019 represented-year claim and OGL v3; ADM1 contains 4 from Eurostat with a 2021 claim and CC BY 4.0. Both have 2023 update/build dates. Product feature-count completeness is separate from incidental global screening counts.

London has 32 geoBoundaries members plus exact Natural Earth City GBR-4809. The separate ownerless geoBoundaries City is a distinct retained feature, not a name-based substitute. All 640 London cells remain held.

All full physical reconstruction/contradictory/container issues remain. Native support does not certify whole targets or present dry land; retained GSHHG data licence notices have conflicting version wording.
Natural Earth country and foreign ADM1 references identify the same 28 contrary centres. Both entire geometries remain negative operands; uncovered country-reference centres remain unknown.

Historical whole-candidate limits remain for 616 overlapping candidates covering 36,404 original centres; 48 of those candidates lack GBR source tags. Complete 95,173-candidate restoration and routing, not a country-filtered shortcut, determines applicability.
Separate 13,001-cell / 79-owner physical-interpretation companion is retained and uncredited. Current accepted overlap must be rechecked at delivery; the original author baseline overlap was zero.
Tests reported here are actual package producer/accounting executions and ten actual writer refusal controls; no whole application or hosted emitted consumer test is claimed.
